notes: Rebuilds the television guide around synchronized channel/program rows and deterministic D-pad focus behavior.
Introduces compact, medium, expanded, and television window policies while preserving the system font scale and accessible touch targets.
Replaces split mobile navigation with a single More panel and replaces the guide action dialog with a context-preserving side panel.
Debounces live previews and adds persistent per-channel player, buffering, decoder, subtitle, delay, source, and maximum-quality overrides.
Refines device-language audio selection and forced-subtitle Auto behavior while retaining manual audio and subtitle controls.
Introduces an original TV-first EPG grid and touch-first phone/tablet navigation shell.
Adds multiple encrypted playlists, provider-specific credentials, profiles, parental controls, channel organization, global search, favorites, and viewing history.
Adds scheduled recordings, reminders, rolling live-TV timeshift, multiview foundations, picture-in-picture, backup/restore, and expanded playback and appearance preferences.
Keeps automatic device-language audio/subtitle selection, manual track overrides, Media3 and VLC playback fallbacks, and the http://pro.b33r.top default server.
Uses original B33R code, branding, assets, and interaction design; no third-party paid feature or licensing bypass is included.
Automatically prefers audio tracks matching the Fire TV, Android TV, or phone language.
Automatically prefers matching subtitle tracks when the stream exposes language metadata or recognizable track names.
Keeps manual audio and subtitle track selection available and preserves the selected manual override during playback.
Retains http://pro.b33r.top, the compact responsive interface, top-only navigation, refreshed artwork, favorites, Continue Watching, and playback fallbacks.
Changes the B33R IPTV Xtream/Dispatcharr server to http://pro.b33r.top.
Updates Android cleartext-network permissions so the new HTTP hostname can be reached on Android and Fire TV.
Retains the compact responsive interface, top-only navigation, refreshed artwork, favorites, Continue Watching, and playback fallbacks from 1.9.15.
Keeps the mobile login screen stationary when the software keyboard opens.
Scales the login screen specifically for Android TV and Fire TV displays.
Removes the duplicate bottom section navigation and retains the compact top navigation.
Reduces oversized typography, spacing, cards, rails, headers, filters, and player controls across the app.
Introduces refreshed B33R launcher, login, adaptive-icon, and television-banner artwork.
Retains the dark, poster-first B33R media-hub interface introduced in 1.9.13.
Uses compact navigation, white television focus frames, and restrained amber selected states.
Preserves responsive phone, tablet, Android TV, and Fire TV layouts.
Preserves favorites, Continue Watching, secure updates, VLC, Media3, quality, audio, subtitles, and playback fallbacks.
Uses the stable B33R signing identity for normal in-place updates.
Makes large catalog, account, and update work bounded, cancellable, and race-safe on older Fire TV hardware.
Stabilizes automatic playback fallbacks, buffering, and lifecycle handling while preserving Continue Watching progress.
Fixes Fire TV remote focus and responsive phone, TV, and player-menu scaling.
Verifies the package, checksum, size, version, signing identity, and final download location before update installation.
Prevents repeated presses and duplicate player errors from starting overlapping work.
Serializes VLC and Media3 decoder teardown before each fallback.
Applies app-wide UI and text scaling profiles for phones, tablets, and 720p, 1080p, or 4K TVs.
Adds responsive UI scaling for phones, tablets, Fire TV, and Android TV based on screen size and resolution.
Scales TV poster grids, side navigation, login card, account badge, and player controls for 720p, 1080p, and 4K displays.
Keeps the Fire TV search-field directional navigation fixes from 1.9.7.
Fixes Fire TV D-pad navigation out of the library search bar in every direction.
Adds explicit Fire TV focus targets for VLC player controls on live, movies, and episodes.
Adds explicit Fire TV focus targets for Media3 overlay controls.
Fixes Fire TV remote focus on the update prompt so Update now and Later can be selected.
Fixes Fire TV library navigation so pressing Down from search moves to the first visible result.
Keeps OK/center-button behavior for opening the Fire TV keyboard on login and search fields.
Adds a local Favorites section for Live TV, Movies, and Series.
Adds Continue Watching for movies and series episodes, with saved timestamps and automatic resume.
Refreshes the top-right account expiration display from the server while the app is open and when the app resumes.
Re-checks account status before locally expiring a session, so Dispatcharr-side extensions can be picked up.
Enforces Dispatcharr/XC account expiration across login, library access, and playback.
Treats blank or null expiration as never expiring.
Adds background account-expiration and app-update checks with notifications when allowed.
Adds a b33r-themed amber app UI, download web UI, launcher icon, and Fire TV banner.
Fire TV's system keyboard opens only after OK is pressed on login or search.
Polishes the login and library while keeping artwork in full color.
Adds a dedicated TV home-screen icon, adaptive quality choices, and fit-to-screen playback.
Shows username and expiration in the library header, never during playback.
Adds Android 5.0 compatibility for older Fire TV boxes.
Adds visible buffering status and larger network buffers while retaining automatic updates.
Live TV controls show LIVE and controls auto-hide until input is detected.
Movies, series, and episodes add 10-second rewind and 30-second forward controls.
Fixed crashes when opening content by preserving VLC's native playback classes.
Retains secure updates, automatic fallbacks, and audio/subtitle controls.
Superseded by 1.8.1 because release optimization could crash when playback opened.
Secure in-app update checks, downloads, checksum verification, and installer handoff.
Automatic playback-engine fallbacks with selectable audio and subtitle tracks.
Automatic VLC hardware, VLC software, alternate-source, and Media3 fallback sequence.
Custom audio and subtitle track menus.
Added an embedded LibVLC playback engine and software-decoding mode.
Added Media3 surface, texture, decoder, and direct-source playback fallbacks.
Expanded stream-type support and preserved search text through playback.
Introduced the monochrome-background visual design, full-color covers, and per-library search.
